# CHINANEWS (chinanews.kr)

> China markets terminal and producer-direct supply desk run by BRIDGE GROUP (ABridge Co., Ltd. · Ecobridge), Gwangju, South Korea. Daily China domestic spot prices for ~405 commodities, Chinese/Korean equity indices, FX and macro data — plus supply of rare earths, gallium, germanium, terbium, tungsten, hafnium, yttrium, 5N/6N high-purity copper, semiconductor materials and Chinese semiconductor components to buyers in Korea and worldwide.

Languages: English (/) and Korean (/ko/). Prices are China domestic spot quotations in CNY unless noted, refreshed several times a day; they are indicative and not investment advice.

## What we supply (request a quote on each page)

- [Rare earths from China](https://chinanews.kr/supply/rare-earths.html): oxides, metals and magnet alloys for Nd, Pr, Dy, Tb, Y, La, Ce, Sm, Gd, Eu, Ho, Er, Yb, Tm, Lu, Sc — purity 3N–5N, COA, samples, export-licence handling.
- [Chinese semiconductors — sourcing](https://chinanews.kr/supply/semiconductors.html): MCUs, power devices (MOSFET, IGBT, SiC/GaN), memory, analog/PMIC, sensors, LEDs from authorised producers and franchised distributors; cross-reference service; export-control screening; no EOL or open-market stock.
- [High-purity copper 5N / 6N](https://chinanews.kr/supply/high-purity-copper.html): 99.999% and 99.9999% ingot, rod, granule with GDMS certificates; OFE C10100; Grade A cathode.
- [Yttrium metal & yttrium oxide 5N](https://chinanews.kr/supply/yttrium.html)
- [Gallium metal 4N–7N & gallium oxide](https://chinanews.kr/supply/gallium.html)
- [Terbium oxide & metal](https://chinanews.kr/supply/terbium.html)
- [Tungsten — APT, oxide, powder, carbide](https://chinanews.kr/supply/tungsten.html)
- [Germanium ingot, GeO2, GeCl4](https://chinanews.kr/supply/germanium.html)
- [Hafnium sponge, crystal bar, HfO2](https://chinanews.kr/supply/hafnium.html)
- [Semiconductor materials](https://chinanews.kr/supply/semiconductor-materials.html): SiC powder and CVD-SiC parts, germanium, polysilicon/silicon metal, HfO2, Y2O3, HF, fluorite, lithium chemicals.
- [All supply pages](https://chinanews.kr/supply/)

## Market data

- [Live terminal](https://chinanews.kr/): indices (CSI 300, SSE, SZSE, ChiNext, STAR 50, HSI, HSCEI, KOSPI, KOSDAQ), FX (USD/CNY, CNY/KRW, USD/KRW), commodity pulse, heatmap, charts, landed-cost calculator.
- [Commodities A–Z](https://chinanews.kr/commodities/): ~405 China spot prices by sector (chemicals, non-ferrous metals, steel, energy, textiles, agriculture, building materials, rubber & plastics); one page per commodity with price history and 52-week range.
- [Daily brief archive](https://chinanews.kr/daily/): advance/decline counts, top movers, sector breakdown, indices, FX, China macro indicators.
- [Sitemap](https://chinanews.kr/sitemap.xml) · [RSS feed of daily briefs](https://chinanews.kr/feed.xml)

## Compliance

Every enquiry is screened before quotation: strategic-items self-classification (Korea YESTRADE) and buyer screening against the U.S. Consolidated Screening List and UN/EU sanctions lists. No quotations to sanctioned parties, military end-users or embargoed destinations.
